description: Branch protection for the default branch, applied by `pnpm repo:host`. `ruleset` is the verbatim body of POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets; nothing else in this file is sent.
reviewPolicy: A sole maintainer cannot approve their own pull request, so a non-zero approval count is a deadlock rather than a gate: nothing would ever merge, and the only way out would be a bypass that also exempts the required checks. The count is therefore zero and code-owner review is off, which keeps the enforcement that matters — no direct pushes, no force-push, linear history, and a green suite before anything lands. `.github/CODEOWNERS` still requests review on harness files; turn `require_code_owner_review` and the count back up the day a second reviewer exists.

requiresAdvancedSecurity.reason: Code scanning and the dependency graph need a public repository or GitHub Advanced Security, and the CodeQL and dependency-review jobs run only when the repository is public, so on a private one they never report. A required check that never reports blocks every pull request forever, so they stay out of the required list by default. Promoting them buys less than it looks even on a public repository: `required_review_thread_resolution` is already on, and CodeQL posts its findings as review comments, so an unresolved alert blocks a merge whether or not the check is required. `pnpm repo:host --code-scanning` promotes them, and a downstream product that is private has to leave them out.
